metadata.title: FCE Gap-Fill - 20 Gaps
metadata.description: Open cloze, 20 gaps plus example. Every gap tests one of twelve areas (prepositions, adverbs, modals, auxiliaries, passive, reported speech, fixed expressions, gerunds and infinitives, linking words, conditionals, phrasal verbs, relative pronouns); 'area' on each gap names it. A slash in an answer lists accepted alternatives.

exercises.title: The Noise in the Attic
exercises.text:

It was not {{11}} my father picked one of the balls up that he realised what they were. They were golf balls – his golf balls. For months he had been complaining that they {{12}} being stolen {{13}} the garage, and had even accused my brother {{14}} taking them.

exercises.title: Lost at the Airport
exercises.text:

exercises.text:

exercises.title: Grandma's Secret Recipe
exercises.text:

exercises.title: The Surprise Party
exercises.text:
For weeks, my sister and I {{0}} been planning a surprise party {{1}} Dad's fiftieth birthday. Keeping it secret was not easy, {{2}} Dad notices everything.
